property_summary: For any amount, a withdrawal via withdraw() either reverts or leaves exactly amount withdrawn from the contract's balance (one reentrant callback in the recipient can at most cause a revert under transfer's 2300-gas stipend), but the mutant forwards all gas so a re-entrant recipient withdraws twice while the outer call still reports success, breaking the balance invariant.
change_summary: Use call instead of transfer, forwarding all available gas.
